items.description: Upgrade to premium carbon frame (elective, bicycle recovered undamaged)
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(c): elective upgrade, not damage from the insured event, and the recovered item was undamaged.

items.description: Brake replacement as part of routine service
items.rationale: Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(a): routine service and replacement not caused by the insured event; no damage to brakes from theft.
Excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(a): general servicing and tune-up, not repair of event damage.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): shipping relates to elective work, not recovery or repair of event damage.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): vehicle costs relate to elective work, not recovery or repair of event damage.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): assembly relates to elective upgrade and service, not repair of event damage.
Excluded by 7.1.8(a): apprentice hours relate to elective and service work, not repair of event damage.
Excluded by 7.1.8(a): skilled worker hours relate to elective and service work, not repair of event damage.
Indemnified under 5.2.2(a): necessary attendance to recover the stolen bicycle, capped by the mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2, 5.2.2). Reference Case 24 supports coverage.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock to release bicycle
items.rationale: Indemnified under 5.2.2(b): necessary to recover the stolen bicycle, capped by the mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2, 5.2.2). Reference Case 24 supports coverage.
Indemnified under 5.2.2(b): skilled labour required for recovery, capped by the mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2, 5.2.2). Reference Case 24 supports coverage.
